post.title: Arcade wants $50 a seat a month. Stepcast is free.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: paying Arcade per seat to replay your own clicks, and renting QR codes that stop working when the subscription does.

segments.quote: Arcade, Supademo and Storylane do the same thing, but cost $32–50 per user per month

cues.say: Arcade: fifty dollars a seat a month

cues.cap: “Arcade, Supademo and Storylane do the same thing,
cues.say: [sarcastic] Arcade, Soopa-demo and Story-lane do the same thing,

cues.cap: but cost $32–50 per user per month…”
cues.say: but cost thirty-two to fifty per user per month.

cues.cap: So: Stepcast. Your demo, one HTML file.
cues.say: [quick] So: Stepcast. Your demo, one H T M L file.

segments.gripe: QR codes that stop working when you stop paying.
segments.quote: The internet doesn’t need another QR code subscription.

cues.say: [matter-of-fact] L M Q Y six six six:

cues.cap: So: QRCode666. The link lives in the squares.
cues.say: [quick] So: Q R Code six six six. The link lives in the squares.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
